units.title: Source, scope, and strength
units.outcome: Qualify a claim without weakening it arbitrarily.

Compare cautious inference with attributed opinion.
Time allocation: 2h close study, 2h reading/vocabulary, 2h listening, 2h writing/translation, 1h speaking, 1h review.

units.title: Accurate reported speech
units.outcome: Preserve viewpoint and certainty in reported statements.
tasks: Interview a partner and report the answers.
Verify certainty, time anchors, and indirect questions.
Time allocation: 2h close study, 2h reading/vocabulary, 2h listening, 2h writing/translation, 1h speaking, 1h review.

units.title: Thematic synthesis
units.outcome: Organize several sources around shared questions.
tasks: Build a thematic table for three sources.
Identify agreement, tension, and missing evidence.
Time allocation: 2h close study, 2h reading/vocabulary, 2h listening, 2h writing/translation, 1h speaking, 1h review.

units.title: The center source pack
tasks: Write a synthesis of the center source pack.
Trace every factual sentence to its source.
Time allocation: 2h close study, 2h reading/vocabulary, 2h listening, 2h writing/translation, 1h speaking, 1h review.

units.title: Argument and recommendation
units.outcome: Defend an actionable recommendation with a real objection.
tasks: Defend a recommendation with an operational condition.
Answer a genuine cost or feasibility objection.
Time allocation: 2h close study, 2h reading/vocabulary, 2h listening, 2h writing/translation, 1h speaking, 1h review.

units.title: Professional email
units.outcome: Request a specific professional next action.
tasks: Write a request, reminder, and disagreement email.
Make the requested next action explicit.
Time allocation: 2h close study, 2h reading/vocabulary, 2h listening, 2h writing/translation, 1h speaking, 1h review.

units.title: Reports and minutes
units.outcome: Distinguish proposals, decisions, and assigned actions.
tasks: Draft minutes that distinguish proposals and decisions.
Write a short report separating evidence and recommendations.
Time allocation: 2h close study, 2h reading/vocabulary, 2h listening, 2h writing/translation, 1h speaking, 1h review.

units.title: Complex time and mood
units.outcome: Control conditions, prior completion, and clause attachment.
tasks: Edit twenty time and mood constructions.
Repair introductory infinitives with missing actors.
Time allocation: 2h close study, 2h reading/vocabulary, 2h listening, 2h writing/translation, 1h speaking, 1h review.

units.title: Specialist reading strategies
units.outcome: Paraphrase unfamiliar material while respecting definitions.
tasks: Read a specialist text in three passes.
Write a plain-language explanation preserving definitions.
Time allocation: 2h close study, 2h reading/vocabulary, 2h listening, 2h writing/translation, 1h speaking, 1h review.

units.title: Francophone adaptation and portfolio

tasks: Compare two francophone recordings without stereotyping.
Adapt and present the final source-based portfolio.
Time allocation: 2h close study, 2h reading/vocabulary, 2h listening, 2h writing/translation, 1h speaking, 1h review.

sentences.fr: Selon les répondants, les horaires sont trop restreints.
sentences.en: According to the respondents, opening hours are too limited.
sentences.note: Selon attributes the opinion to a specified group.

sentences.fr: Les chiffres laissent penser que la demande pourrait augmenter.
sentences.en: The figures suggest that demand could increase.
sentences.note: Laisser penser and conditional pourrait preserve cautious interpretation.

sentences.fr: Il est possible que cette mesure convienne aux salariés.
sentences.en: It is possible that this measure will suit employees.
sentences.note: Il est possible que governs subjunctive convienne.

sentences.fr: La directrice a annoncé que le centre ouvrirait le lendemain.
sentences.en: The director announced that the center would open the following day.
sentences.note: Conditional marks future viewed from a past reporting point.

sentences.fr: Elle demande si le centre sera ouvert demain.
sentences.en: She asks whether the center will be open tomorrow.
sentences.note: Si introduces an indirect question, so future is possible.

sentences.fr: Les deux enquêtes convergent sur ce point.
sentences.en: The two surveys converge on this point.
sentences.note: Converger sur specifies the point of agreement.

sentences.fr: Elles divergent toutefois quant au coût.
sentences.en: They differ, however, regarding the cost.
sentences.note: Diverger quant à introduces the dimension of disagreement.

sentences.fr: La portée de l'enquête reste limitée.
sentences.en: The scope of the survey remains limited.
sentences.note: Portée here refers to scope or reach.

sentences.fr: Le coût est estimé à mille quatre cent quarante euros, hors sécurité.
sentences.en: The cost is estimated at one thousand four hundred and forty euros, excluding security.
sentences.note: Estimé and hors preserve the estimate's status and exclusions.

sentences.fr: Une expérimentation permettrait de mieux évaluer les besoins.
sentences.en: A trial would make it possible to assess needs better.
sentences.note: Conditional presents the proposed measure's expected benefit.

sentences.fr: Je recommande que la direction publie un bilan.
sentences.en: I recommend that management publish a review.
sentences.note: Recommander que takes the subjunctive in this construction.

sentences.fr: Cette réserve ne remet pas en cause l'intérêt du projet.
sentences.en: This reservation does not call the value of the project into question.
sentences.note: Remettre en cause means to call into question.

sentences.fr: Pourriez-vous m'indiquer la marche à suivre ?
sentences.en: Could you tell me the procedure to follow?
sentences.note: Conditional pourriez creates a polite request.

sentences.fr: Je ne peux pas confirmer cette estimation en l'état.
sentences.en: I cannot confirm this estimate as it stands.
sentences.note: En l'état qualifies the document's current form.

sentences.fr: Aucune décision définitive n'a été prise.
sentences.en: No final decision has been made.
sentences.note: Aucune plus ne expresses absence; passive prise agrees with décision.

sentences.fr: Si l'équipe avait été consultée, l'erreur aurait pu être évitée.
sentences.en: If the team had been consulted, the error could have been avoided.
sentences.note: Plus-que-parfait condition pairs with conditional past consequence.

sentences.fr: Une fois que le budget aura été approuvé, nous publierons les horaires.
sentences.en: Once the budget has been approved, we will publish opening hours.
sentences.note: Future anterior marks completion before a future action.

sentences.fr: Après avoir consulté les riverains, la direction publiera sa décision.
sentences.en: After consulting local residents, management will publish its decision.
sentences.note: The understood subject of the introductory infinitive is la direction.

sentences.fr: Les résultats doivent être interprétés avec prudence.
sentences.en: The results should be interpreted cautiously.
sentences.note: The passive participle agrees with plural résultats.

sentences.fr: Le nombre de visites ne correspond pas au nombre de personnes distinctes.
sentences.en: The number of visits does not correspond to the number of distinct people.
sentences.note: The sentence preserves an important measurement distinction.

grammar.prompt: Il est possible que la demande ___.
grammar.explanation: Il est possible que takes the subjunctive; augmente is present subjunctive.

grammar.prompt: Elle demande ___ le centre ouvrira demain.
grammar.explanation: Si introduces an indirect yes/no question and may be followed by future.

grammar.prompt: Elle a annoncé lundi que le centre ___ le lendemain.
grammar.explanation: Conditional expresses future viewed from the past reporting frame.

grammar.prompt: Je recommande que la direction ___ le bilan.
grammar.explanation: Recommander que requires subjunctive publie here.

grammar.prompt: Si le financement avait été confirmé, nous ___ commencer.
grammar.explanation: An unreal past condition takes a conditional past consequence.

grammar.prompt: Une fois que le budget ___ approuvé, nous commencerons.
grammar.explanation: Future anterior marks completion before a future action.

grammar.prompt: Après avoir consulté les riverains, ___ publiera sa décision.
grammar.explanation: The introductory infinitive needs the same understood actor as the main subject.

grammar.prompt: Les réponses que nous avons ___ sont anonymes.
grammar.explanation: Preceding direct object réponses is feminine plural.
Aucune décision is singular and passive prise agrees with décision.

grammar.prompt: The sources agree: Les sources ___ sur ce point.
grammar.explanation: Converger sur means to converge or agree on a point.

grammar.prompt: A neutral reporting verb here is: Le rapport ___ que les locaux sont disponibles.
grammar.explanation: Indique reports information without the distancing implication of prétend.

grammar.prompt: Thirty-six out of sixty respondents means sixty percent of...
grammar.explanation: The denominator is the respondents, not the whole population.
Remercier quelqu’un pour quelque chose is a standard construction.
En pièce jointe is the attachment phrase; jointe agrees with pièce.

grammar.prompt: Après que la direction ___ le planning, elle informera les usagers.
grammar.explanation: Standard careful usage has indicative after après que; future anterior fits the future sequence.
